info.title: Contoso Order Status API
info.description: Read-only API hosted on Azure Functions that returns the current status of a Contoso customer's order. Used by the Contoso Support Assistant agent as an OpenAPI tool.

servers.description: Overridden at provisioning time by ORDER_API_BASE_URL (scripts/provision_agent.py).

get.summary: Get the status of a customer's order
get.description: Returns the status of the customer's most recent order, or of a specific order when orderId is supplied. Call this only when the customer asks about order status, tracking, carrier, or delivery date and has provided a customerId in the format CUST-12345. Always returns HTTP 200 for lookups: check `found` - when it is false, `error` is OrderNotFound, InvalidCustomerId, or InvalidOrderId and `message` explains why.

parameters.name: customerId
parameters.description: The customer's unique ID: 'CUST-' followed by exactly five digits, e.g. CUST-10001.

parameters.name: orderId
parameters.description: Optional specific order ID: 'CON-' followed by exactly six digits, e.g. CON-500101. Omit to get the most recent order.

200.description: Lookup completed. `found` is true with order details, or false with an `error` code and `message`.

value.message: No order was found for customer CUST-99999.
customerId must match the format CUST-12345 (CUST- followed by 5 digits).

401.description: Missing or invalid function key (returned by the Azure Functions host with an empty body).

example.message: The order service is temporarily unavailable.

functionKey.name: x-functions-key
functionKey.description: Azure Functions function key. Supplied by a Foundry 'Custom keys' project connection whose key name is x-functions-key.

OrderStatusResponse.description: Result of an order lookup. When found is false, only customerId, error and message are present.

found.description: True when an order was found; false for unknown or malformed IDs.

customerId.description: Customer ID that was looked up (echoed back, normalised to upper case).

region.description: ISO 3166-2 style shipping region code, e.g. US-WA, US-AK, CA-ON, GB-LND, DE-BE.

carrier.description: Carrier name once the order has shipped.

trackingNumber.description: Carrier tracking number once the order has shipped.

estimatedDelivery.description: Estimated delivery date for orders not yet delivered.

lastUpdated.description: UTC timestamp of the last status change.

itemCount.description: Number of items in the order.

otherOrderIds.description: Other order IDs on the same customer account.

error.description: Present only when found is false.

message.description: Human-readable explanation when found is false.

ErrorResponse.description: Returned only for unexpected server faults (HTTP 500).
